content: Xuwuhani Kerutsareme nuaka kaniwarukuxeɨrieni Kura nuiwarimama meta Wenikamini, xeitsienituyari heimana nauka tewiyari miriyari (180.000) kuyaxi mekanakɨne yunaitɨ, mɨwatakwinikɨ 'ixaheritsixi hikɨ mɨpaɨ tiyurieme yunaime wahetsie mɨtita'aitakɨ.
Peru Yawé niukieya kaninuani Tsemahiyaxi hetsɨa, mɨkɨ tewi Kakaɨyari payexeiyakai, mɨpaɨ 'aneme niuki kaniupitɨarieni:
«Mɨpaɨ ketineutahɨawi Xuwuhani Tsarumuni nu'aya mɨti'aitame Kura kwieyaritsie, meta yunaime 'ixaheritsixi Kura kwieyaritsie memɨtitei meta Wenikamini,

mɨpaɨ kanaineni Yawé: “Hawaikɨ xepɨkawakwitɨweni yu'iwama 'ixaheritsixi. Yuxexuitɨ yukie xekeneutayeixɨa, karikɨ ne yanehainekaku mɨyakatiniuyɨni”». Hikɨ mɨkɨ mekanenu'enieni Yawé niukieya meta mekateniuhayewa Keruwuhani metamienike.
Xuwuhani Kura kiekariyarite 'aixɨa kaniutiyurieni
Merikɨte Xuwuhani Kerutsareme kaniuyuhayewa, hikɨ kiekarite Kura mieme 'ikɨ 'aixɨa kaniutiyurieni:
Wereni, 'Etami, Tekuha,
Wetsuxi, Tsuku, 'Arurani,
Kahati, Maretsa, Tsipi,
'Arurahini, Rakixi, 'Atseka,
Tsura, 'Ayaruni meta Hewuruni. 'Ikɨ kiekarite 'aixɨa muti'itɨarie kanimiemetɨkaitɨni Kura kwieyaritsie meta Wenikamini kwieyaritsie.
Xuwuhani kuyaxi tewa'aitɨwamete kaniwaru'uitɨani, kiekarite kuraruyari 'amatitɨtɨ tawari 'akanetitɨriya, meta mana 'ikwaite katiniuti'uta, hatseiti meta winu,
meta katiniyetuani yuheima nunuwamete meta pitsikate. Mɨpaɨ naime kiekarite 'aixɨa kaniukuyurieni, hikɨ Kura meta Wenikamini kwieyaritetsie ti'aitatɨ kanayani.
Rewitsixi meta mawari wewimamete Xuwuhani mekaniuparewieni
Naitsarie kiekatari 'Ixaheri kwieyaritsie mekaniu'axɨani mawari wewiwamete meta rewitsixi para Xuwuhani memɨtinɨnikɨ.
Rewitsixi yukwie mekaniuku'eirieni memɨtehatihɨwetsie meta hipame yupiinitɨarika Kura kwieyaritsie pɨta memɨyehukɨ meta Kerutsareme, Keruwuhani meta niwemama Yawé memayexeiyani memɨkawapitɨakaikɨ.

Wahetsiemieme, Keruwuhani kaniwarutihɨawe yuhetsiemieme mawari wewiwamete tukiteta kakaɨyarixi memɨtewamawiriekakɨ, tsipuri wa'ɨkiyari memɨwarayexeiyanikɨ meta tsikerutsixi muwaruti'aitakai memɨtiwewiyanikɨ.

Rewitsixi wa'utɨma mekanekɨne teɨteri yunaitɨ 'Ixaheri nuiwarimama wahetsiemiemete yu'iyarikɨ Yawé memɨkuwautɨwekai, 'Ixaheri Kakaɨyarieya. Kerutsareme mekaniu'axɨani Yawé mawari memɨwewirienikɨ, yu'ukiyarima wakakaɨyari.

Mɨkɨ memu'axɨakɨ kaniutatɨrɨkaxɨani Kura kwieyaritsie ti'aitame, meta Xuwuhani Tsarumuni nu'aya mekaniuparewieni haika wiyari metatsiere Rawiri meta nu'aya Tsarumuni mekaniwaranukuweiya heitserie kememɨte'u'uwakai.
Xuwuhani 'ɨitamama meta niwemama
Xuwuhani kaniutiwitɨni Makarati Kerimuti nu'aya, Rawiri nu'aya meta 'Awikahiri, 'Eriyáwi niweya meta 'Itsahi teukarieya.
Mɨkɨtsie tɨɨri mɨwarayexei mekanihɨkɨtɨni Kehutsi, Tsemariyaxi meta Tsakani.
'Ariketa Mahaka kaniutiwitɨni 'Awitsaruni niweya. Mɨkɨtsieta kaniwarayexeiya 'Awiyaxi, 'Atahi, Tsitsa meta Tserumiti.

Xuwuhani Mahaka waɨkawa kaninaki'eriekaitɨni 'Awitsaruni niweya keyuri hipame yu'ɨitama meta te'uximayatametemama 'ɨitamamatɨtɨ. 'Ɨitamama yunaitɨ mepɨyupaɨmekai tamamata heimana 'atahaika meta haika tewiyari mepɨyupaɨmekai te'uximayatametemama 'ɨitamamatɨtɨ, meta yuniwema puwarayexei xeitewiyari heimana 'atahaika 'ukitsi meta haika tewiyari 'ukari.
Xuwuhani 'Awiyaxi kananukakeni yu'iwama mɨtiwa'aitɨakakɨ Mahaka nu'aya, ti'aitame payanikekai mɨpaɨ pɨtiku'eriyakai.

Hikɨ timaiweme payuyeitɨa, hipame yuniwema waɨkawa pɨtiwayetuiri piinitɨarika, meta waɨkawa 'ukari puwakuniukiri wa'ɨitama memakɨne, hikɨ Kura kwieyaritsie naitsarie kaniwareutanɨ'axɨani meta Wenikamini kwieyaritsie, metatsiere naime kiekari yukuraru 'amatitɨtɨ mexeiyatɨkatsie.
